findings.action: The producer branch replaces the bounded listing runner with captureGovernanceGit. Production closeout supplies a producer at closeout_plan.go:303-308. captureGovernanceGit uses the 512 MiB governanceReadViewMaxInputBytes limit (governance_read_view_git.go:78-79 and governance_read_view.go:25) and context.Background (governance_read_view_git.go:114-115), so its recursive listing has neither R5's 64 MiB limit nor its two-minute deadline. It can retain oversized metadata before the entry guard and wait indefinitely for Git. TestGitTreeListingIsBounded exercises only calls without a producer and misses this production route. Apply the listing-specific limit and deadline through the governed context capture API while preserving read-view provenance, and add producer-path byte-limit and deadline regressions.
